description: This file defines the PdfLongIntegerObject class, which represents a 64-bit signed integer object used in the PDF processing library PdfSharp. It includes constructors, a property to get the value, and methods for string representation and writing the object to a PDF writer.

classes.name: PdfLongIntegerObject
classes.description: Represents an indirect 64-bit signed integer value within the PDF document structure.

methods.name: PdfLongIntegerObject()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes a new instance of the PdfLongIntegerObject class.

methods.name: PdfLongIntegerObject(long value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a specific 64-bit integer value.

methods.name: PdfLongIntegerObject(PdfDocument document, long value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance associated with a specific PDF document and a value.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the long integer value, invariant to culture.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Writes the object to a PDF via the provided PdfWriter.
